t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I can go for the red basket by getting gnomes who are red, pink, purple and brown.  Or I can go for the yellow basket by going with the gnomes who are blue purple green and yellow. I should follow one colour of basket until I get 0 mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: You will choose between 2 gnomes.  If you pick a red, pink, purple or brown gnome these will take you to a red basket.  If you select a blue, green or yellow gnome this will take you to a yellow basket.  The idea is to keep selecting gnomes to get the red backet until you get 1 or 0 mushrooms and then switch to select gnomes to get the yellow backets until again you get 1 or 0 mushrooms.  Keep alternating between baskets this way until you are out of time.
